name: scope-validate-lint-to-changed-packages
title: Scope validate --lint to changed packages so backend-only changes do not fail on unrelated missing deps
description: Bug 4 from the 2026-06-15 ClawCreek bug report (Lattice 0.3.5), verified in source. validate --lint (a REVIEW->TEST CLI gate) runs tsc --noEmit recursively over EVERY tsconfig in the repo (validate-lint.ts findTsconfigs/runTsc) with NO change-scope filter. In a freshly-bootstrapped story worktree, node_modules is not installed, so a backend-only change hard-fails the lint gate on unrelated frontend TS2307 'Cannot find module' errors (echarts/react-markdown/vitest/etc). runSingleTsc correctly distinguishes a missing tsc binary (ENOENT -> skip) from a non-zero tsc exit (missing deps -> kind:'fail'), so missing deps is a hard fail, not a skip. Outcome: a backend-only change is not blocked by an unrelated, uninstalled frontend package — add an optional change-scope filter (only tsc the tsconfigs covering changed files/packages) and/or skip-with-warning when an out-of-scope package has no node_modules, while still type-checking in-scope packages. Note: installing deps (CLAUDE.md F-003 npm install) is the immediate operational fix; this story is the framework-side scoping improvement. Scope: lint change-scoping only; not gitRoot cwd (B-2856).
